I genuinely don't have any words for this 🤯

Just ONE image of a robotic bee and somehow got this incredibly gooood 3D model with great topology.

No prompt. No rework. No retries. Nothing else.

This kind of thing could have taken weeks of modeling, retopology and iteration. Or https://t.co/Q54h0e3zSv
@thebuggeddev You can also try Tencent's Hunyuan 3D. It offers a daily free allowance and is also very user-friendly, and can be used in conjunction with Tripo.
@thebuggeddev I also tried Tripo, and it’s amazing. The quality and level of detail it can produce are seriously impressive.

@thebuggeddev Tripo AI is really good. The hardest part for games is creating clean, separate low-poly modules. It may handle this better in the future, but for now there are still many limitations for actual game use.
